notes.title: Wind Jester Spark Plushie Announcement and Release!
notes.notes:
Follow the link here: https://www.makeship.com/products/the-wind-jester-plush

Its the wind jester! From Spark TEJ 1, but in the style of Spark TEJ 3.
While the wind jester was not present in the third game, this plushie is a cannon look into how the wind jester would look like in Spark TEJ 3.

Its only available for a limited time before its gone forever, so get it before it is gone!
